title: Layout transition of a D24_UNORM_S8_UINT attachment names only the stencil aspect
expect_note: no existing diagnostic code covers a barrier subresource aspect mask; nearest is timing.wrong-layout (depth aspect left UNDEFINED)
fix_note: maintainer committed a fix (not linked from the issue); the fixed variant sets DEPTH | STENCIL aspects, as the VUID requires
expected_finding: the UNDEFINED -> DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL barrier on surface_stencil (D24_UNORM_S8_UINT) has aspectMask STENCIL only; the depth aspect is not transitioned while the image is used as a depth/stencil attachment (VUID-VkImageMemoryBarrier-image-03320)
